I posted this on /v/facesets but I figured I'll add it here as well:

I don't think the creator of the script (MotorCityCobra) has a voat account, but his script face-ripper-9000, based on the GetFaces script, will greatly simplify your faceset making process compared to using the FakeApp extract feature manually. The reason I'd reccommend this script over the original script is that GetFaces can only handle one video at a time, will output your facesets with incorrect dimensions, and will name output filenames randomly making sorting frustrating.

Currently the faceset making process consists of downloading a set of videos, converting them each to individual frames using FFMPEG, searching through each data set to delete any frames with multiple faces, extracting your results and then going back through your data to delete any errors. With face-ripper-9000, all you need to do is download a set of videos as well as a picture of the person who's face you want to extract, and the script will run through each clip and extract only frames containing faces that match the input photo, outputting them in 256x256, ready to be used for training. It will also automatically put any particularly bad frames into a seperate folder.

You'll still have to go through your final set and check for any errors, but it completely removes the hassle of having to first convert your videos to individual frames, and having to delete multiple faces in your data set before extracting them.
